about: Blocked trademark terms (CLAUDE.md hard rule 7). The single shared list read by tests/unit/ipHygiene.test.ts and by the forge gen-ai wrapper (SSP-012). It lives in tools/ so the scans never flag the list itself; never move it under src/data/ or assets-src/ai/.
matching: Case-insensitive: the text and the term are both lowercased before matching.

Inside a term, every run of characters that are not letters or digits (space, hyphen, dot, apostrophe) matches any run of zero or more non-letter, non-digit characters in the text, so 'Grand Theft Auto' also blocks 'grand_theft_auto', 'GrandTheftAuto' and 'grand-theft-auto'.

match 'word': the hit must not touch a letter or digit on either side; underscore, dot, hyphen and space all count as boundaries, so 'gta' blocks 'GTA' and 'prop.gta_sign' but not 'agta'. Used for short or ambiguous terms.
match 'substring': the term may sit inside a longer word, so 'Paperboy' also blocks 'paperboys'. Used for long, distinctive terms only.
deliberately_not_listed: Coke: also the gasworks fuel, and LEVEL_DESIGN names the in-game Coke Street (district.gasworks).
Walkers: collides with ordinary English (dog walkers, the GDD's pedestrians). Describe crisp packets generically instead.
